pages.title: Chapter Overview
pages.text: Assemble Kunwu clues, prepare for hostile caverns, and contest the mountain's sealed treasures.$(br2)This chapter contains 4 authored quest lines. The index describes routes and does not replace server progress.

pages.title: Assembling the Kunwu Clues
pages.text: Kunwu does not wait open: without every clue, its gate remains sealed.

pages.title: Yin-Yang Cavern Intelligence
pages.text: In a cavern steeped in yin poison, buy survival before buying directions.

pages.title: Nascent-Soul Material: Yin Zhi Horse
pages.text: The alchemical ingredient must be captured alive; a corpse is worth far less.

pages.title: Kunwu Mountain Expedition
pages.text: With every clue assembled, enter the mountain where sealed fire and demons wait.
